products.name: Macrina Baguette
products.description:
Everything that Leslie Mackie creates tastes really good. It's a gift, and fortunately the greater Seattle area has been able to enjoy this gift for the last 20 years. This is her version of a classic French baguette. The interior is soft and chewy, with a crisp, hearty crust. The end is perfect to eat while walking to your car, the rest can be enjoyed in all the ways really good bread should be.

*Delivered fresh daily - orders placed in the evening will be filled with the next day's fresh delivery.

products.name: Macrina Piadina, 6pk
products.description: Ok, these things are total game changers. I know you take pride in your pizza dough, but let's face it, you don't always have time to make it. Likewise, fresh baked bread that is still warm is equally hard to come by. Even slicing, oiling and grilling a nice baguette takes effort. Piadina is the cure. Build pizzas and fire them at home...oil up both sides and brown in a skillet until crunchy/chewy and top with a pinch of sea salt...pair with meats cheeses & antipasti...you can even store them in the freezer until you are ready to use them! There is literally no downside. Buy these, you won't regret it.

products.name: DeLaurenti Pizza Dough, 2 pack
products.description: You know them. You love them. You find them in our freezer section across from the cafe. Take them home, let them thaw for a few hours, roll them out and you are all set! 2 Pack

products.name: Share Crackers Everything Sourdough Crackers, 154g
products.description:
Share Crackers is a sourdough cracker company based in Detroit that focuses on using only ethically-sourced ingredients, intriguing flavors, and artisanal baking methods. The results are carefully crafted and delicious crackers – a heartwarming snack that centers around the act of sharing.

Enjoy the classic blend of sesame, poppy seed, black pepper, garlic, and onion—a nostalgic nod to your favorite breakfast, now with a satisfying crunch. Perfect for snacking, pairing with dips, or adding to your next charcuterie board.

products.name: Share Crackers Plainish Sourdough Crackers, 154g
products.description:
Share Crackers is a sourdough cracker company based in Detroit that focuses on using only ethically-sourced ingredients, intriguing flavors, and artisanal baking methods. The results are carefully crafted and delicious crackers – a heartwarming snack that centers around the act of sharing.

These olive oil and sea salt inspired crackers are simple but offer a subtle umami. Bold in flavor and deeply satisfying, they bring a simply delicious vehicle to any snack board or appetizer spread. Already a staff favorite!

products.name: DeLaurenti Gluten Free Pizza Crust, 12"
products.tagline: Just top, bake & enjoy! No more eating salad while your family eats pizza!
products.description: Everyone else is eating pizza and feeling great. You're not. We get it. Gone are the days when you are relegated to ordering the caeser with some chicken and no croutons. This GF pizza crust is legit! Par baked and ready to be your canvas! Sauce, top & bake in a hot oven or BBQ and you are back in the game!

products.name: Di Marco Pinsa Crust, 2pk
products.description: Pizza night just got a lot easier...and better. Pinsa, not to be confused with pizza, is your ticket to recreate amazing Roman-style pizza. It couldn't be easier! Top this par-baked authentic, hand-formed crust with your favorite toppings, bake it off and you are enjoying the flavor of Rome in the comfort of your own home! Seriously...these are just amazing. Cook them right on the rack, on a pizza stone, or even on the grill! Need a make-shift foccacia? Brush with olive oil, herbs & sea salt, bake and you're done! Try them and you won't go back to making your own pizza dough!

products.name: Mitica Valencianos Rosemary Crackers, 4.4oz
products.description: These crunchy crackers from Spain have a unique long shape and are formed by hand from a rich dough made with extra virgin olive oil and sea salt. The ingredient list is short, and the flavor payoff is huge.

products.name: Mitica Valencianos Sea Salt Crackers, 4.4oz
products.description: These crunchy crackers from Spain have a unique long shape and are formed by hand from a rich dough made with extra virgin olive oil and sea salt. The ingredient list is short, and the flavor payoff is huge.

products.description: Ok, these little taralli are amazing. The first challenge is to have any around to actually eat with other meats or cheeses after you have opened the box and started in on them standing in the kitchen, or in the car on the way home!

They are perfectly crisp with crunchy flecks of sea salt and calabrian chili pepper. Great with your favorite antipasti spread, with a glass of wine, on a salad, or as we mentioned, right out of the box!

products.name: Danieli Taralli with White Wine, 250g
products.description:
Just like their savory counterparts, these lightly sweet taralli are soon to become your go-to snack. Each ring is gently coated in granulated sugar, creating a delicate crust that adds just the right amount of sweetness and striking the perfect balance between cookie and cracker.

The dough, crafted from wheat flour, olive oil, white wine, and a hint of vanilla, is boiled and then baked to a golden, crisp finish. Just like Danieli's signature taralli, these Puglian treats are irresistibly crunchy and endlessly snackable. Enjoy them with coffee, dessert wine, or simply on their own.

products.name: Danieli Traditional Taralli Crumbs, 300g
products.description: If you love Danieli Taralli, you'll love these. Finally, the equivalent of top quality bread crumbs are available without all the preservatives and junk. Super fresh and crunchy, they are perfect to finish your anchovy pasta or provide the perfect crust on your famous mac & cheese!

products.name: La Panzanella Garlic Mini Croccantini, 6oz
products.description: Started more than 20 years ago in Seattle's Capital Hill neighborhood, family owned La Panzanella still uses the freshest, highest quality local ingredients to make their crackers & cookies. Their mini garlic Croccantini is the perfect complement to cheeses, tapenades and charcuterie. The mini two bite size make the perfect platform for plated appetizers and antipasti spreads.

products.name: La Panzanella Original Croccantini, 8oz
products.description: Started more than 20 years ago in Seattle's Capital Hill neighborhood, family owned La Panzanella still uses the freshest, highest quality local ingredients to make their crackers & cookies. Simply seasoned only with coarse sea salt, their Original Croccantini are the perfect complement to cheeses, tapenades and charcuterie. Reminiscent of flat bread, croccantini is meant to be broken by hand and shared.

products.name: Flufa au Fromage, 125g
products.description:
What is a flufa? I hate to answer a question with a question, but does it really matter what you call something if it's really, good? Sure there is a technical answer: a fancy cheese twist. If you have not had these, I'll let a good friend of the store describe them...

"These are so good I am confused. How can anything be this good? I'm reading the ingredients and it doesn't make sense. Flour...butter...cheese...I mean, what is going on here?!"

Try for yourself.

products.name: Flufa Tete de Moine Rosette, 125g
products.description: If you have had Tête De Moine, you know. Translated, it simply means "Monk's Head." I know, that's not the most appetizing name for anything edible, but when the thing that it is describing is really good, it ceases to matter. Here we have the union between this beautiful cheese, and a crisp, buttery rosette cracker. Similar to it's cheese twist cousin, the rosette gives you another shape to enjoy!

products.name: Le Veneziane GF Grissini
products.tagline: You'll never know these are Gluten Free!
products.description: Gluten Free People Unite! So it's been awhile since you've had a breadstick? No need to wait another day. These sticks have a satisfying crunch and are ready to swirl prosciutto & scoop your favorite dips & spreads! From the folks at Le Venenziane, makers of fantastic GF pasta!

products.name: Macrina Greek Olive Crostini
products.description: Macrina makes things that taste really good, their Greek Olive Crostini are no exception. This thinly sliced olive bread brushed with olive oil and toasted is a great alternative to crackers. Perfect with your favorite cheeses & cured meats, or right out of the package!

products.name: Macrina Sardinian Flatbread w/Truffles
products.description: Every time we have tried to import the classic Sardinian flat bread, they would always arrive looking like broken chips rather than flat bread. Macrina solved this problem. This traditional cracker bread is made with semolina flour, brushed with olive oil and sprinkled with truffle sea salt. Break them up and enjoy them with everything!

products.name: Mitica Onion Toketti, 198g
products.tagline: Made by hand with roasted onion in Sardinia!
products.description: So what the heck are these things, anyway? Well, besides being really, really good, Toketti di Pane Carasau are satisfying, bite-sized snacks made from the traditional Sardinian flatbread called Pane Carasau. Dating back to ancient times, it is a thin and crispy bread made with semolina. Toketti combine the authentic flavor of Sardinia with an irresistible crunch. When fried, the bread crisps up into a snack reminiscent of tortilla or pita chips. They are an ideal accompaniment to dips, charcuterie, and cheese.

products.description: Uncle Jerry's has been hand-making true sourdough pretzels in Lancaster, Pennsylvania for 20 years. They now have a strong national following, and we're one of the few places to sell these west of the Mississippi River. These gourmet pretzels are slow-baked and blackened. Perfect with a cold beverage of your choice.

products.description: Uncle Jerry's has been hand-making true sourdough pretzels in Lancaster, Pennsylvania for 20 years. This is the original, flagship pretzel - perfect with a cold beverage of your choice.

products.name: Macrina Sour Ficelle
products.description: The warmth and good food that are the soul of Macrina Bakery & Café owe their origins to owner-chef Leslie Mackie - one of the most esteemed figures on the national artisan baking scene. In short, everything she creates tastes amazing, and her Sour Ficelle is no exception. This demi-baguette has a rustic crust with a mildly sour and chewy interior. Great for sandwiches, cheese, crostini, soup...you name it!

products.name: Mitica Pane Di Musica Rosmarino, 100g
products.description: These golden feather-light semolina flatbread crackers are alluringly crispy and thin. The aroma of freshly baked bread and toasted flavor are enhanced by a drizzle of olive oil and fresh rosemary. This style of flatbread has ancient origins and has been a Sardinian specialty for thousands of years. Historically, it was a staple of shepherds who needed a shelf-stable bread to last through the long winters and transhumance. This variation, paper-thin with a drizzle of olive oil & rosemary, is known as pane guttiau in Sardinian. It is enjoyed as a delicate and savory cracker that can pair with anything from olives to cheese and charcuterie. The poetic name of Pane di Musica evokes sheets of parchment used for notating music.

products.name: Mario Fongo Grissini Integrale, 100g
products.description: "Il panaté", this is how people in Piedmont call their village baker, and Mario Fongo still likes to identify his firm with this term, since it is a place where delicious bread specialities are baked every day. Mario Fongo's history is intertwined with the little town of Rocchetta Tanaro, in the heart of the province of Asti, where their first village bakery was opened in 1945. Their breadsticks are something to behold. These beauties are hand-stretched with whole wheat flour, imparting a pleasant rustic flavor. Their perfect snappy texture is ideal for twirling prosciutto, dunking into dips and eating straight from the package!

products.description: These gluten free blank slates of awesomeness are ready to do exactly what they are told. No delusions about being the lead singer in the band. They live to serve. So...pile them with your favorite cheese, charcuterie, dips or spreads and call it good!

Now Rustic Bakery makes dozens of products, while still operating 4 bakeries in the Bay Area. This artisan flatbread is made with olive oil and French sea salt. Relatively neutral in flavor, it pairs perfectly with a wide variety of meats and cheeses.

products.name: Storye Classic Rye Bread
products.description: Storye (Stor-eye) is made in Riga by the Laci Bakery, a traditional maker of dense, dark Latvian rye breads made with just a few ingredients. Everything is done by hand, using wooden tools and baked slowly in wood-fired brick ovens. Using only locally-grown rye—and no wheat—the dough is naturally fermented with a starter handed down from the bakery founder’s grandmother, which gives it a malty tang. Their Classic Rye is moist and rich with a full, zesty flavor. Latvians use it for open-faced sandwiches, sometimes just with a simple smear of butter. Or layer it with pastrami, sauerkraut, Swiss cheese, and Russian dressing for the perfect Reuben sandwich.

products.name: Storye Fine Rye Bread
products.description: Storye (Stor-eye) is made in Riga by the Laci Bakery, a traditional maker of dense, dark Latvian rye breads made with just a few ingredients. Everything is done by hand, using wooden tools and baked slowly in wood-fired brick ovens. Using only locally-grown rye—and no wheat—the dough is naturally fermented with a starter handed down from the bakery founder’s grandmother, which gives it a malty tang. Their Fine Rye is lighter in texture than their Classic Rye because they remove the hard exterior of the rye berry before milling, which creates a more refined rye flour. The addition of caraway seeds gives the Fine Rye extra zing. Slices of this loaf will remind you of the best Jewish deli rye you’ve ever sampled.

products.name: Asturi Classic Olive Oil Bruschettini, 120g
products.description: These bruschettini are baked in Italy using an age-old artisan recipes that contains only all natural ingredients. products.name: Effie's Oatcakes, 7.2oz
products.description: These lightly sweet, classic tea biscuits are unlike any you’ve tasted. A fourth generation family recipe, these original Oatcakes are crisp and buttery with layers of toasted oats and a hint of salt. They pair very well with many cheeses and offer a great crunch!

products.name: Gran Pavesi Tomato Crackers, 250g
products.description: Gran Pavesi crackers are ubiquitous in Italy. The original bakery was founded by Mario Pavesi in 1937 in the Piedmont region. On the strength of its traditional crackers and cookies, it grew from a tiny regional bakery into one with international reach. Their Pomodoro Cracker is crisp and has a rich tomato flavor. Excellent with soft cheeses like chevre and brie.

products.name: Mulino Bianco Cracker Salati, 500g
products.description: Mulino Bianco makes more than just cookies! We love these simple yet savory crackers. They are made through a long, natural leavening process, followed by a rolling process that combines very thin layers of dough, giving the product its characteristic flavor and crispiness. Individually packed into 20 portions to keep our snacking under control!

products.name: Mulino Bianco Crackers Integrali, 500g
products.description: Mulino Bianco makes more than just cookies! These crackers are simply 100% whole wheat flour and sourdough starter, thats it! No regrets here. Individually packed into 20 portions. Snack through a packet, take a break and be assured that the next one will be just as fresh!

products.name: Mulino Bianco Fette Dorate, 315g
products.description: So you're telling me that these little golden rusks come pre-toasted and ready for my jam? Perfect. These are the Italian classics and a staple in markets in the Old Country. Thse thick slices of lightly toasted bread are just the right level of crumbly. Top them with butter & jam and fire up the coffee maker!

products.name: Yiayia and Friends Graviera Cheese Rusks, 2.1oz

Oven-baked and infused with the distinct flavor of the spicy graviera cheese made in Crete, yiayia’s cheese rusks can be served as appetizers with dips, or as a super-healthy and delicious alternative to croutons in salads.

products.name: Yiayia and Friends Olive Oil and Oregano Rusks from Crete, 2.1oz
products.description: Yiayia knows good, solid food that is healthy, tasty, and filling – and can be enjoyed in dozens of different ways. Infused with the distinctly Mediterranean flavors of olive oil and oregano, yiayia’s rusks can be served as appetizers with dips, or tossed with olive oil, tomato, and soft white cheese to make yiayia’s favorite “Dakos” salad.
